title: Yes and No
label: ch:hi-yes-and-no
canDo: I can say yes and no in Hindi and use नहीं to negate a whole sentence.

payoff.summary: Answer yes with हाँ and politely with जी हाँ, then say नहीं, put it in front of a verb — मैं नहीं जानता — and hear the single PIE \*ne behind no, non and nein.
payoff.note: HI-C07-nahin recalls the plain and polite yes (and the moon-dot that nasalises hāṃ) before its own no: 5 of the chapter's 7 atoms. The other two are one-character recognition segments (HI-S02-letter-na, HI-S111-letter-ka, sequence 505-506) that come after the payoff in reading order, so it cannot honestly assess them.
